company.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Condolitoral condominium management is a condominium management company with over 20 years of activity, operating mainly in Vila Nova de Gaia, Espinho and Santa Maria da Feira. We have 5 employees divided between external and internal services. In our business relationships we always value personal, close contact. We have preferential agreements with service providers in all areas, allowing us to offer co-owners a fast and efficient service.
The quality of our services and our experience are recognised by our co-owners.
We appreciate your contact regarding the management of your building.
